title: The battlefield changes when the Guru is with you
summary: The Guru turns life's hard field into a place of victory. Let mercy become more believable than the threat.
takeaway: Let mercy become more believable than the threat.
lifeApplication: Before the next defensive move, bring the breath back under one line of refuge and mercy.
